showList.label: Show the table list by default
showList.help: Lists the database's tables and views in a sidebar when it opens. Changes apply immediately.

pageSize.label: Rows per page
pageSize.help: How many rows one page of the grid holds. Changing it returns to the first page; the reader accepts at most 500.

settings.label: 默认显示表列表
settings.help: 打开数据库时在侧栏列出全部表与视图；修改立即生效。

settings.label: 每页行数
settings.help: 数据网格一页显示多少行。修改后回到第一页；每次读取最多 500 行。
